reason: Article 26 of the DORA Delegated Regulation requires ICT third-party risk management, which includes testing business continuity plans. The requirement to test 'at least once a year' and consider 'severe but plausible scenarios' is a standard and logical component of such testing requirements.

Article 11(6) of the DORA Regulation pertains to the content of the ICT risk management framework, specifically requiring the identification of critical or important functions. It does not contain any provisions related to the frequency or methodology of testing business continuity plans.
